授業概要
Students will understand how language and verbal/non-verbal communication works. They will learn to analyze functions of language and communication in contemporary issues. This course starts with fundamental questions such as “What is communication?” and “What is language?” It further provides an overview of the state-of-the-art research and major issues in the field of Communication to pursue their relevance to today’s society.
